create.messageBody:
These words are the only way to restore your account. If you lose them, your funds are gone for good — no one can recover them, not even Salmon. 

 Anyone who sees these words can take your funds. Never share them with anyone and never enter them into any form. 

 Salmon Team will never ask for your recovery phrase or private keys.
